title: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
mechanism: JEPA prediction loss plus SIGReg, which pushes embeddings to an isotropic Gaussian; one hyperparameter, no teacher or stop-grad, stable on ResNets and ConvNeXts, enabling in-domain pretraining on ~10k images.
adaptation: Train R34 and ConvNeXt V2-Nano from scratch on the 11.9k pool, 1-ch, 256 to 512 px with small crop scales so 1 to 2 px cracks survive; second arm adds SIGReg on per-patch features (dense variant, untested). Then U-Net++ PF fine-tune.
min_experiment: LeJEPA 400 epochs on 11.9k (~40 GPU-h per backbone) then PF vs ImageNet init of the same backbone; out-of-fold relF1@2, E1 recall, 2 seeds; kill as a model arm if below ImageNet on relF1@2 and E1 recall.
evidence: R (full text 6.3): on Galaxy10 (11k images, 400 epochs) in-domain LeJEPA on ResNet-18/34, ConvNeXt V2-Nano, LeViT beat DINOv2 ViT-S and DINOv3 ViT-S transfer, frozen and full fine-tune, 3 seeds; classification only.
prior_overlap: none: no joint-embedding or from-scratch in-domain SSL was run.
